description: This file defines the UtilityPaymentService class, which handles utility payment processing, including creating payment entities, invoking external banking services, updating transaction statuses, and retrieving payment records with pagination.

classes.name: UtilityPaymentService
classes.description: Service class responsible for processing utility payments, interfacing with repository and external banking client, and providing payment retrieval functionality.

methods.name: utilPayment
methods.description: Processes a utility payment request: saves initial transaction, calls external banking service, updates transaction status, and returns a success response.

methods.name: readPayments
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of utility payments, converting entity objects to DTOs for external use.
